messages.subject: Best Subsets
parts:
Hi
I ran this code earlier today and it totally worked fine.
But best subsets seems to be finicky and now it isn't working.
Does anyone have any tips on how to get this code to work?
tnx

bestSubsets=regsubsets(DailyRinsePos~ Hatchery, BreederLoc, RanchID, Livability, FirstWkMort, SecondWkMort, DensityIn, AgePU, Gall, Airsac9, TotalCellt, Plant, DensityOut, LitterRun, CloseWeek, data = Broiler, really.big=T, nbest=2)

Error message:
Error in model.frame.default(data = Broiler, weights = BreederLoc, AgePU,  : 
  object 'Gall' not found
